plan.purpose: Check persistence of the short-window traffic outlier; retain the original observation regardless of outcome.

analysis_policy.policy: For each planned agent count, pair, side, and scenario, use the earliest window that passed the original workload/cadence/presentation checks. Retain valid windows from subsequently aborted attempts. Use later whole-run retries only to fill missing/invalid scenarios; retain all other valid windows as supplementary evidence.
analysis_policy.reason: A later detached source-rate failure must not remove an earlier valid 275.7 kB/s attached result. Applying the same first-valid rule to every scenario and both sides prevents performance-based selection.

continuations.name: n32-p0-before
continuations.reason: One baseline producer recorded zero writes in an active five-second sample; daemon stayed alive. Exclude the invalid workload attempt in full and retry unchanged, retaining full producer receipts for diagnosis.
continuations.policy: Exclude entire failed attempt; rerun identical inputs. Retain stopped homes/producer receipts for diagnosis.

continuations.name: n32-p0-after
continuations.reason: All 32 producers stalled for roughly 0.6 seconds inside synchronous PTY writes during detached spammy, falling below the required source rate. Preserve the entire failed attempt, including its earlier 275.7 kB/s attached sample, and retry the full trial unchanged.
continuations.policy: Exclude entire failed attempt; rerun identical inputs. Retain stopped homes/producer receipts for diagnosis.

cpu_unit: percent of one logical core, all process threads, user+system; differences in percentage points
bandwidth_unit: bytes/second accepted on actual viewer-daemon Unix sockets, both directions, including framing

placement.reason: No candidate passed 2%; least busy selected before paired measurements

notes: Two trials per build by default, ABBA order at each count. Means and individual paired differences; not confidence intervals. CPU is untraced; bandwidth is a separate traced window. First valid window per planned scenario, including valid windows in later-aborted attempts; other valid retry windows retained separately.
